items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: So I went down to his house and taken lessons. And I found out that I got more out of Anormatwire than I did out of the rest of the people

ctx.x: And he went along in the district for a little while after. He didn't play many more places. He just played around. He'd come into places. He never lost friendships with me. And I did come to my head that I wanted to take lessons from him. So I went down to his house and taken lessons. And I found out that I got more out of Anormatwire than I did out of the rest of the people that had showed me anything in the music business. So I rapped so fast and playing in the cabaret at night, and all those white shows come…
Was it a regular cabaret or what was it like?
